reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
convert aggregate functions into sum and count pairs

WITH filtered_demographics AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'M'
      AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
), filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
), filtered_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
), sales_by_item_state AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        st.s_state,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sum_quantity,
        COUNT(ss.ss_quantity) AS cnt_quantity,
        SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS sum_list_price,
        COUNT(ss.ss_list_price) AS cnt_list_price,
        SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_coupon_amt,
        COUNT(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_coupon_amt,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales_price,
        COUNT(ss.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_sales_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN filtered_dates d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_stores st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, st.s_state
), sales_aggs AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        sb.s_state,
        sb.sum_quantity,
        sb.cnt_quantity,
        sb.sum_list_price,
        sb.cnt_list_price,
        sb.sum_coupon_amt,
        sb.cnt_coupon_amt,
        sb.sum_sales_price,
        sb.cnt_sales_price
    FROM sales_by_item_state sb
    JOIN item i ON sb.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    s_state,
    GROUPING(s_state) AS g_state,
    SUM(sum_quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_quantity), 0) AS agg1,
    SUM(sum_list_price) / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_list_price), 0) AS agg2,
    SUM(sum_coupon_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_coupon_amt), 0) AS agg3,
    SUM(sum_sales_price) / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_sales_price), 0) AS agg4
FROM sales_aggs
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, s_state)
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
